title: just, already, yet
goal: 현재완료에 just(방금), already(벌써), yet(아직)을 붙여 일이 끝났는지 아닌지 말할 수 있어요.

points.title: just = 방금
points.body: have / has와 p.p. 사이에 just를 넣으면 '방금 ~했다'예요. I've just finished my shift.(방금 근무 끝났어요)

points.title: already = 벌써, 이미
points.body: already도 have / has와 p.p. 사이에 넣어요. 생각보다 빨리 끝났을 때 써요. She has already paid the rent.(벌써 집세 냈어요)

points.title: yet = 아직 (부정문)
points.body: 부정문 끝에 yet을 붙이면 '아직 ~ 안 했다'예요. I haven't found a job yet.(아직 일자리 못 구했어요)

points.title: yet = 벌써? / 이제? (의문문)
points.body: 의문문 끝의 yet은 '벌써(이제) ~했어?'라는 뜻이에요. Have you had lunch yet? 대답은 Yes, I have. / Not yet.(아직이요)

points.title: 자리 정리
points.body: just와 already는 have와 p.p. 사이, yet은 문장 맨 끝이에요. 긍정문의 '이미'는 already, 부정문의 '아직'은 yet이에요.

formula: 주어 + haven't / hasn't + p.p. + yet (아직 안 했다)

mistakes.wrong: I have finished just my shift.
mistakes.right: I have just finished my shift.
mistakes.why: just는 문장 뒤쪽이 아니라 have와 p.p. 사이에 넣어요.

mistakes.wrong: I have paid the rent yet.
mistakes.right: I have already paid the rent.
mistakes.why: 긍정문에서 '이미/벌써'는 already예요. yet은 부정문과 의문문에 써요.
부정문의 '아직'은 yet이고, 문장 맨 끝에 와요.

examples.en: She has already paid the rent.
We've already booked our tickets to Cairns.
examples.ko: 우리는 이미 케언즈 가는 표를 예매했어요.

examples.en: I haven't found a job yet.
He hasn't replied to my message yet.
examples.ko: 그는 아직 내 메시지에 답장을 안 했어요.

quiz.sentence: I've ___ finished my shift. I'm so tired.
Don't worry. I have ___ booked the hostel.
quiz.ko: 걱정 마. 내가 벌써 호스텔 예약했어.

quiz.answer: He hasn't read the email yet.
choices: He hasn't read the email already.
He hasn't readed the email yet.
He haven't read the email yet.
He hasn't read the email yet.

quiz.answer: Have you seen the movie yet?
choices: Have you saw the movie yet?
Have you seen the movie yet?
Did you seen the movie yet?
Have you seen yet the movie?
quiz.why: 의문문의 yet은 문장 맨 끝, see의 p.p.는 seen

quiz.answer: I've just made a coffee for you.
choices: I've just make a coffee for you.
I just've made a coffee for you.
I've just made a coffee for you.
I've just maked a coffee for you.
quiz.why: have just + p.p., make의 p.p.는 made
의문문 끝은 yet, the package는 Has + p.p.

quiz.answer: My housemate has already cleaned the kitchen.
choices: My housemate has cleaned already the kitchen.
My housemate has yet cleaned the kitchen.
My housemate has already cleaned the kitchen.
My housemate have already cleaned the kitchen.
quiz.why: already는 has와 p.p. 사이, My housemate는 has
